mapper.sql: car01_info_id AS info_id, car01_car_type AS car_type, f_cdnm('CarTypeCode', car01_car_type, car01_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS car_type_nm, car01_car_no AS car_no, car01_car_nm AS car_nm, car01_car_info AS car_info, car01_note AS note, car01_init_mileage AS init_mileage, ( SELECT f_emp_kor_nm(car02_person_id) FROM car02_user WHERE car02_info_id = car01_info_id ORDER BY car02_start_date DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS person_nm, ( SELECT car02_start_date FROM car02_user WHERE car02_info_id = car01_info_id ORDER BY car02_start_date DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS start_date
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO car01_info (car01_info_id, car01_company_id, car01_car_type, car01_car_no, car01_car_nm, car01_car_info, car01_note, car01_init_mileage) VALUES (#{infoId}, #{companyId}, #{req.carType}, #{req.carNo}, #{req.carNm}, #{req.carInfo}, #{req.note}, #{req.initMileage})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM car03_booking a INNER JOIN car01_info b ON a.car03_info_id = b.car01_info_id WHERE car03_info_id = #{infoId}
